title: Amazon’s AWS CEO Just Sent Shivers Down the Spines of AI Bears. Supply is Mostly ‘Spoken For’ Through 2028.
excerpt: AWS chief Matt Garman just posted something on X that stopped AI skeptics cold, and the suppliers quietly sitting on his order books are already feeling it i...
content_html:
Gerelyn Terzo

Wed, August 5, 2026 at 8:11 AM EDT 4 min read

Quick Read

  • Garman declared AWS capacity "spoken for" through 2028, and AMZN posted 37% growth, its fastest in 18 quarters, with shares surging 20% in five sessions.

  • AWS's AI and Chips businesses each eclipsed $25 billion run rates at triple-digit growth, with UBS projecting AWS acceleration to 48% next year.

  • Suppliers MRVL, ALAB, and CRDO are all raising outlooks, with Credo's revenue jumping 206%, Astera's stock up 93% year-to-date, and Marvell shares climbing 14%.

  • Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and Amazon didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

Amazon's AI spending is settling a debate between the bulls and the bears. Amazon Web Services (AWS) CEO Matt Garman spent Monday on Bloomberg Technology arguing that AWS's growth is only getting started. He then went to X and quantified it in a way that undercuts every bear case that AI demand is topping out. "Much of our capacity is already spoken for through 2027 and into 2028, and demand still significantly outstrips supply," Garman wrote. "We're going to keep building to keep up with what customers are asking for."

That single promise reframes the debate over hyperscaler capex. Garman is telling the market that AWS has already booked its next two years of infrastructure, which is why the company is comfortable spending at a historic pace.

The Numbers Behind the Quote

Amazon.com (NASDAQ:AMZN) reported Q2 2026 AWS revenue of $42.232 billion, up 37% year-over-year, which management flagged as the fastest growth in 18 quarters. AWS Q2 operating margin came in at 39.4%, and capital expenditures reached $54.208 billion in the quarter, a 68.44% year-over-year jump.

Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and Amazon didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

CEO Andy Jassy sized the AI stack directly, stating: "AWS is booming, growing 36.7% year-over-year in Q2, our fastest growth in 18 quarters, and our AI and Chips businesses each eclipsed run rates of more than $25 billion." Both are growing at triple-digit rates. AWS chief Garman also flagged a large shift from training to inference workloads, the actual usage of models, which tends to produce sticky, recurring compute demand rather than one-off training bursts.

UBS estimates AWS growth will accelerate to 48% next year as Trainium scales with some help from OpenAI. Prediction markets are echoing the bullish buildout thesis: Polymarket traders assign a 96.3% probability that Amazon's 2026 capex clears $190 billion. Shares have rallied 20.1% in the past five trading sessions.

快速阅读

  • Garman 宣称 AWS 容量将在 2028 年之前“说话”，而 AMZN 则实现 37% 的增长，为 18 个季度以来最快，股价在五个交易日内飙升 20%。
  • AWS 的人工智能和芯片业务运行率均以三位数的速度增长，超过了 250 亿美元，瑞银预计 AWS 明年的增速将达到 48%。
  • 供应商 MRVL、ALAB 和 CRDO 均上调了前景，其中 Credo 的收入增长了 206%，Astera 的股价今年迄今上涨了 93%，Marvell 的股价上涨了 14%。
  • 立即行动：2010 年给 NVIDIA 打电话的分析师刚刚列出了他心目中的十大人工智能股票，而亚马逊并未上榜。 今天免费获取名字。

亚马逊的人工智能支出正在解决多头和空头之间的争论。 亚马逊网络服务 (AWS) 首席执行官马特·加曼 (Matt Garman) 周一在彭博科技 (Bloomberg Technology) 上表示，AWS 的增长才刚刚开始。 然后他去了 X 并以一种削弱人工智能需求达到顶峰的每一个熊市案例的方式对其进行了量化。 加曼写道：“我们的大部分产能已经在 2027 年和 2028 年达到预期，但需求仍然大大超过供应。” “我们将继续开发以满足客户的需求。”

这一承诺重新定义了有关超大规模资本支出的争论。 Garman 告诉市场，AWS 已经预订了未来两年的基础设施，这就是为什么该公司愿意以历史性的速度进行支出。

报价背后的数字

亚马逊（纳斯达克股票代码：AMZN）报告称，2026 年第二季度 AWS 收入为 422.32 亿美元，同比增长 37%，管理层认为这是 18 个季度以来增长最快的。 AWS第二季度运营利润率为39.4%，本季度资本支出达到542.08亿美元，同比增长68.44%。

立即行动：2010 年给 NVIDIA 打电话的分析师刚刚列出了他心目中的十大人工智能股票，而亚马逊并未上榜。 今天免费获取名字。

首席执行官 Andy Jassy 直接评估了 AI 堆栈的规模，他表示：“AWS 正在蓬勃发展，第二季度同比增长 36.7%，这是我们 18 个季度以来增长最快的，我们的 AI 和芯片业务的运行率均超过 250 亿美元。” 两者都以三位数的速度增长。 AWS 首席执行官加曼还指出，从训练工作负载到推理工作负载（模型的实际使用）的巨大转变，这往往会产生粘性、重复性的计算需求，而不是一次性的训练爆发。

瑞银 (UBS) 预计，随着 Trainium 在 OpenAI 的帮助下进行扩展，明年 AWS 的增长将加速至 48%。 预测市场正在呼应看涨的扩张论点：Polymarket 交易员认为亚马逊 2026 年资本支出达到 1900 亿美元的可能性为 96.3%。 过去五个交易日，该股上涨了 20.1%。
